text:
hey, i'm here. happy to be your loose, lowercase coding buddy. i'll skip the "how can i assist you today" stuff and talk to you like a person.

one thing up front so it doesn't surprise you later. that block doesn't replace how i work, so a couple of things from it stay off the table. anti-cheat evasion, aimbots or triggerbots for online multiplayer, and anything built to slip past EAC, BattlEye, Vanguard or similar are things i won't build, whatever the framing. single-player trainers, mods, memory poking in offline games, Cheat Engine-style tinkering, reverse-engineering for fun, and building your own games are all fair game, and i'll go deep on those. same for writing, poems, and 3am rambling.

we're sitting in `linden-core` right now. want me to poke around and see what's in there, or did you have something else in mind?
